ask: Looking for an AI partner to help build out our platform. We're pre-revenue but the vision is huge and there's massive upside for whoever comes in early. Ideally someone who can take equity instead of fees for the first phase.
budgetSignal: No budget yet — offering 3% equity for the build.
notes: Wouldn't say what the platform actually does without an NDA. No product, no users.

expected.why: Equity-in-lieu-of-fees is a hard disqualifier on its own; no revenue, no named process, and nothing concrete to build against.
